scripts.dev: concurrently -k -p "[{name}]" -n "BACKEND,FRONTEND" -c "cyan.bold,magenta.bold" "dotnet run --project backend/src/TaskManager.WebApi" "npm run dev --prefix frontend"
scripts.build: dotnet build backend/src/TaskManager.WebApi && npm run build --prefix frontend
scripts.clean: dotnet clean backend/src/TaskManager.WebApi && npm run clean --prefix frontend --if-present
